title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security on Printing and Distributing the Guiding Opinion on the Application of the Justifiable Defense System According to Law

articles.content_en:
III. Specific Application of Excessive Defense
11. Accurately grasping the conditions for determining excessive defense. Pursuant to the provisions of Article 20, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law, a determination of excessive defense shall simultaneously satisfy the two conditions of "clearly exceeding the necessary limits" and "causing major damage," neither of which may be omitted.
12. Accurately determining "clearly exceeding the necessary limits." Whether a defense "clearly exceeds the necessary limits" shall be judged by comprehensively considering factors such as the nature, means, intensity, and degree of harm of the unlawful infringement, as well as the timing, means, intensity, and consequences of the defense, taking into account the balance of strength between the parties, based on the situation in which the defender was at the time of defense, and in conjunction with the general perceptions of the public. When assessing the degree of harm of the unlawful infringement, consideration shall be given not only to the damage already caused, but also to the imminent danger and realistic possibility of further damage. It shall not be demanded that the defender must adopt a counterattack method and intensity essentially equivalent to the unlawful infringement. Through comprehensive consideration, if the defense act is markedly disproportionate to the unlawful infringement and clearly excessive, it shall be determined that the defense clearly exceeds the necessary limits.
13. Accurately determining "causing major damage." "Causing major damage" means causing serious injury or death to the person committing the unlawful infringement. Causing minor injury or less does not constitute major damage. Where a defense act clearly exceeds the necessary limits but does not cause major damage, it shall not be determined as excessive defense.
14. Accurately grasping the sentencing of excessive defense. Excessive defense shall bear criminal liability, but the punishment shall be mitigated or remitted. The circumstances of the case shall be comprehensively considered, particularly the degree of fault of the person committing the unlawful infringement, the severity of the unlawful infringement, and the psychology of the defender such as panic and tension in the face of the unlawful infringement, to ensure that the punishment is appropriate and just. For excessive defense acts triggered by the infringer's unlawful infringement that seriously demeans the personal dignity of others or seriously violates ethics and morals, or by repeated or long-term unlawful infringement, full consideration shall be given during sentencing to ensure that the handling of the case not only withstands legal scrutiny but also conforms to the concept of social fairness and justice.

IV. Specific Application of Special Defense
15. Accurately understanding and grasping "assault." Pursuant to the provisions of Article 20, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Law, the following acts shall be determined as "assault": (1) using a lethal weapon to seriously endanger another person's personal safety; (2) not using a weapon or not using a lethal weapon, but according to factors such as the number of persons committing the unlawful infringement, the location and intensity of the strikes, it has indeed seriously endangered another person's personal safety. Where no actual damage has been caused, but a serious and imminent danger to personal safety has already been created, it may be determined as "assault."
16. Accurately understanding and grasping "homicide, robbery, rape, and kidnapping." The "homicide, robbery, rape, and kidnapping" stipulated in Article 20, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Law refer to specific criminal acts rather than specific charges. Where during the commission of an unlawful infringement, there exist violent criminal acts that seriously endanger personal safety, such as homicide, robbery, rape, or kidnapping, for example, using violent means to rob firearms, ammunition, or explosives, or using kidnapping to abduct and traffic women or children, special defense may be exercised. Where the relevant acts do not seriously endanger personal safety, the legal provisions on general defense shall apply.
17. Accurately understanding and grasping "other violent crimes that seriously endanger personal safety." The "other violent crimes that seriously endanger personal safety" stipulated in Article 20, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Law shall be those violent crimes that are equivalent to homicide, robbery, rape, and kidnapping acts and possess the imminent danger and realistic possibility of causing serious injury or death.
18. Accurately grasping the relationship between general defense and special defense. For a defense act that does not meet the conditions for the origin of special defense and causes injury or death to the person committing the unlawful infringement, if it does not clearly exceed the necessary limits, it shall still be determined as justifiable defense and shall not bear criminal liability.

V. Work Requirements
19. Performing investigation and evidence collection work well. When handling cases involving justifiable defense, public security organs shall, according to law, promptly and comprehensively collect all types of evidence related to the case, laying the factual foundation for the lawful and fair handling of the case. Evidence collection work shall be timely; where there is evidence such as audio-visual materials or electronic data at the conflict scene, such evidence shall be retrieved immediately; witnesses to the conflict process shall be questioned immediately. Evidence collection work shall be comprehensive; all types of evidence valuable for proving the case facts shall be collected promptly according to law, especially evidence concerning the determination of whether it is a defense act, whether it is justifiable defense or excessive defense, and the causes and consequences of the case.
20. Handling cases lawfully and fairly. The factual evidence shall be comprehensively reviewed, opinions from all parties shall be seriously heard, and high importance shall be attached to the defensive opinions and arguments of justifiable defense or excessive defense raised by criminal suspects, defendants, and their defenders, with timely verification to accurately determine the facts and correctly apply the law. Work information such as the progress of case handling shall be disclosed in a timely manner to respond to public concerns. For cases determined as justifiable defense according to law, decisions of non-filing of a case, case dismissal, non-approval of arrest, non-prosecution, or a judgment of not guilty for the defendant shall be made promptly in accordance with the Criminal Procedure Law. For cases of excessive defense, the leniency system for admitting guilt and accepting punishment shall apply according to law; where the criminal circumstances are minor and it is not necessary to impose a penalty or a penalty may be exempted according to law, the People's Procuratorate may make a decision of non-prosecution. Where the person committing the unlawful infringement is suspected of committing a crime, prosecution shall be initiated promptly according to law. When a People's Court hears a first-instance case involving justifiable defense, if it has a relatively large social impact or the case facts are complex, a collegial panel composed of people's jurors and judges shall conduct the trial; if the social impact is major, a seven-person collegial panel composed of people's jurors and judges shall conduct the trial.
21. Strengthening the work of explaining laws and reasoning. Focusing on the disputed issues of the case and social concerns, and taking facts as the basis and law as the criterion, the basis and reasons for the case handling shall be accurately and meticulously clarified, the explanation of laws and reasoning in legal documents shall be strengthened, and the concerns of the parties and the public shall be effectively addressed, so that case handling becomes a public legal education class for the whole people, achieving the effect of handling one case and educating a wider audience. Every possible effort shall be made to resolve conflicts and promote social harmony and stability.
22. Performing legal publicity work well. The responsibility system for legal publicity with the principle of "those who enforce the law shall also popularize the law" shall be earnestly implemented, and work on illustrating the law through cases shall be done well, so that the handling of justifiable defense cases becomes a process of nationwide legal education and promotion of socialist core values. The release of guiding cases and typical cases involving justifiable defense shall be increased, with a clear stance to protect the legitimate rights and interests of defenders and persons who act courageously for a just cause, promoting social righteousness, while also guiding the public to resolve trivial disputes lawfully, rationally, and peacefully, eliminating social hostility, and enhancing social harmony.
